svg.text: For the Open Innovation theme, Inner Weather turns your stress level into the sky behind the time: when your
heart-rate variability is healthy it is a clear, sunlit morning, and as stress rises clouds gather until a storm
breaks. Instead of another number to decode, you feel your state at a glance, and a storm offers a one-tap breathing
break. Always-on keeps the time and a single word forecast on true black.
368 × 448 rectangular OLED · text ≥ 21 px · icons ≥ 25 px · always-on on true black · all names fictional, no logos · Designed by Amritha S
